title: Next Shiba Inu? Bybit Wins Dubai Exchange Licence as DOGE, PEPE and Remittix's PayFi Expansion Take Focus
ai_summary: Bybit secured a Dubai licence to offer crypto spot-trading services, adding a regulated market. Remittix is expanding its PayFi to 41 additional fiat currencies, having raised about $33 million from over 40,000 participants. The project plans a 300 million RTX burn at launch, removing 20% of supply.

title: Bybit AI Empowers Users with Their Personal Financial Edge, Adding Personalization and Memory
ai_summary: Bybit announced new personalization and memory features for its in-app AI assistant, Bybit AI. The AI now builds a user profile from assets, positions, behavior, and risk profile, and retains long-term memory of preferences. Bybit expects further updates as it builds toward AI-native financial services.

title: New Prize Pool Unlocked: Bybit Extends USD1 Hold & Earn Program With 27 Million WLFI in Rewards
ai_summary: Bybit extended its USD1 Hold & Earn program with a 27 million WLFI reward pool, running from October 17 to November 15, 2026. Eligible users holding at least 1 USD1 earn daily WLFI rewards with up to 10% APR, no staking required.

title: Bybit Adds Stock Trading and Tokenised Equities in TradFi push
ai_summary: Bybit launched trading in over 1,000 US stocks and ETFs, with fractional share support and 24-hour access. It is developing mStocks, a tokenised equity product backed one-to-one by real securities, targeting a November launch. The exchange also offers IPO Express, with SpaceX as the first offering.
